thread:
maya: Quick heads-up: I opened a short docs PR to add a migration note for Optimize toolkit covering batching + prefix/KV caching and an SDK snippet to warm the cache. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234  
sam: Nice — can you include a tiny runnable Python snippet that shows batching + cache policy? reviewers like copy/paste examples. Also add expected perf numbers (ballpark). 
maya: Pushed a first-pass snippet into the PR, example below — keeps it minimal:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
# enable continuous batching and prefix cache
resp = client.generate(
  model="open-lm-3b",
  input="Summarize this...",
  batching={"max_batch_size":16, "max_wait_ms":10},
  cache={"prefix_cache": True, "ttl_s": 3600}
)
print(resp.text)
```
sam: That's perfect. For perf notes, can you add: ~2-3x token/sec improvement for repeated prefixes on 3B models (internal bench), and mention results vary by seq len. 
eli: Saw the PR — a couple of quick fixes: 1) the quant profiles link is broken (currently points to /quantization/legacy); we need it to point to /optimize/quant-profiles and call out that q8_0 was renamed to q8_1 in the runtime. 2) CI flagged a linter on the snippet (unused import). I can paste a tiny change if you want. 
maya: Thanks — will update links and remove the unused import. Re: q8_0 -> q8_1, good catch, I'll add a short migration note: "If you previously used q8_0, switch to q8_1 and test generation quality; see runtime/quant-notes." 
tara: I'll take the nav redirect for the broken link — adding a docs-side redirect from /quantization/legacy -> /optimize/quant-profiles and trimming the example to <30 lines. Also can someone add a one-line callout about cache cold-warm tradeoffs? reviewers ask for that. 
maya: Added a one-liner: "Warm caches for recurring prefixes to reduce per-token compute; expect higher p95s during cold start." 
docs-bot: deploy-preview: Created preview for PR #5234 -> https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/docs/5234 (expires in 72h) :white_check_mark: 
eli: Quick nit: change "p95s" to "p95 latency" and add a link to the Optimize caching section anchor. Otherwise LGTM. 
maya: Updated both, removed unused import, fixed links, and added perf note. Marking for review again — @sam @eli can you skim when you have 30s? 
sam: Skimmed, looks good to me. Approving in PR. :thumbsup: 
eli: Approved as well, thanks everyone. I'll queue a follow-up tiny PR to add an SDK snippet for Node later. 
maya: Thanks team — merging after CI green.
